content: Rahul Jain contacted insurance agent Sunita Agarwal to inquire about the online claim process for potential water damage related to a new kitchen remodel. He also asked about the timing of the first premium auto-debit. Sunita provided the claim guide document, informed him that the first premium of ₹12,500 will be auto-debited on 05/10/2026 with a reminder email beforehand, and shared the payment schedule.

action_items: File water-damage claims online via the portal if needed
Ensure funds are ready for the first premium auto-debit on 05/10/2026
